saints.name: St. Scholastica
saints.title: Virgin
saints.shortBlurb: The sister of St. Benedict, consecrated to God from her youth, whose last meeting with her brother won a storm from heaven by the force of her love…
biography: Scholastica was the sister of St. Benedict, born about 480 at Nursia, and was consecrated to God from her earliest years. She lived in a community of nuns not far from Monte Cassino and met her brother once a year for holy conversation.

St. Gregory the Great relates that at their last meeting she begged Benedict to stay through the night; when he refused, she prayed, and a sudden storm made his return impossible, so that “she was able to do more because she loved more.” Three days later Benedict saw her soul rise to heaven as a dove, and he laid her body in the tomb he had prepared for himself.
saints.knownFor: Her holy life as St. Benedict’s sister.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 10 February
